newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.79 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.79 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills was rose to 15.79 percent at the latest weekly tender, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.984 billion rand. The average price was 96.065 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 15.09 percent from 15.07 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 590 million rand. The average price was 92.475 rand percent.
